notes.title: New update for "Heaven and Hell" with some fixed glitches
notes.notes: We are just uploading a major update for our game "Heaven and Hell"! In the version we had online on Steam so far, all modes, epsiodes and levels were free accessable from the very start. This was a glitch we fixed due to customers complaining. If you update to the new version, unfortunatley you will have to start the game from the beginning. We also improved some of the graphic asstes and corrected some text errors.
